rv.q: At its heart is a highly magnetic performance from Emma Corrin, playing the handsome young nobleman who time-travels through centuries and, at the age of 30, wakes up as a woman. It’s hard to remember a bolder entrance than this: Orlando walks on stage in a silky shirt, stretches, and happens to reveal the fact he’s not wearing any pants.
What anchors attention is the coruscating Corrin...you're ever in the presence of pure star quality.
Mac's tour-de-fierce performance is reason enough to plan a visit to Orlando.
